Description: Shas'o keyword is written two ways. Summary table (page 8): Personnage Lié (Attached Character), plus Elite (2), QG, Génie Tactique. Unit card ability list (page 29): Personnage (Character), plus Elite (2), QG, Génie Tactique — not Personnage Lié. Both give Morale Lié and Save 4+f.
Note: Shas'el is Attached Character in both table and card.

Description: Interceptor Drone morale is written as both Attached and none. Summary table (page 8): Moral —. Unit card (page 32): Moral Lié, and the abilities include Personnage Lié.
Note: Army list still attaches them only to Flyers.

Description: AX1-0 Tiger Shark main gun is written two ways
Suggestion A: the numbers match Light Rail Cannons. Summary table (page 10) and card profile (page 37): Canons à Rail Léger (45 cm / 2 / 4+ / −3, Dégâts (+1)). Card prose (page 37): Ses Canons à Ions ont Dégât (+1). These are two different Games Workshop weapons.
Suggestion B: Follow table and card stats: Light Rail Cannons.
Chosen: Burst Cannons with Turret agree in all three places.

Description: Heavy Gun Drones card describes two support sizes
Suggestion A: the army list only has one. Card (page 22): two bases become Attached Characters, or four bases form a normal detachment. Army list (page 17): only 2 bases attached for +50. MV1 Attack Drones have both the 4-base detachment (75) and the 2-base attached option (+25).
Suggestion B: Follow card: also allow a 4-base Heavy Gun Drone detachment.
Note: Follow army list: attached 2-base formation only.

Description: Off-table submunition Seeker Missiles is on the card and not on the summary table. Summary table (page 12): tracer salvo has Missiles à Guidage Laser and Dégâts (+1)
Suggestion A: submunition salvo has Gabarit (12 cm), Réduit les Couverts (−1), Endommage les Bâtiments (PA −4/2) — no Seeker. Card (page 41): submunitions have Seeker Missiles as well as those other abilities.
Suggestion B: Follow table: Seeker only on the tracer salvo.
Note: Follow card: Seeker on both salvos.
Chosen: Keep both: table without Seeker on the submunition, card with Seeker. Note at both places that this is an inconsistency in French 3.1.0.

Description: Ta'unar weapon count is written two ways on the same card. Prose (page 40): équipé de deux Armes de Bras. Summary table (page 12) and card profile (page 40): Choisir 1 Arme principale et 2 Armes secondaires, plus the hull Smart Missiles and Twin Burst Cannon. Weapons list is on page 13.
Suggestion A: Follow tables: 1 primary and 2 secondary (plus hull guns).
